fusions.name: Festoon
fusions.desc: Fires a sting that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it reaches and stuns it for 0.8 seconds. It then leaps to 3 more enemies within 4 tiles, each hit dealing 70% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Short Tether
fusions.desc: Sweeps a cone 4 tiles ahead of you that deals 4 poison damage to everything in it, with a 15% chance per hit to leave the target [Pinned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Every Link Holds
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 6 tiles in place for 3 seconds. While it lasts, a swarm fights beside you, striking for 4 every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: No Slack Given
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 10% poison resistance.
